name: Eco Friendly Unisex Canvas Laptop bag / Messenger bag
description:
Let’s start the revolution of saving our Earth from plastic pollution by inspiring our fellow-beings.
Our environment-concious SaveGlobe’s Cot Clay Travel Bag Collection presents an impressive, designer ecofriendly chocolate-brown canvas unisex Sling Bag-cum-Messenger Bag for men and women of all ages.
This all-rounder Messenger bag has 1 main compartment with a metal zip to arrange books, files, and electronic gadgets, etc. Additionally, the bag has two internal pockets with zips for stationery items.
This sturdy and multi-purpose Messenger bag’s outer layer and handles are made of long-lasting strong cotton canvas while the inner layer is soft and flexible as it is lined with cotton Kora-fabric for better and improved quality finish.
Among our stunning eye-catcher models, this head-turner and all-rounder Messenger bag is a great attractive choice for personal uses such as a shopping bag, college bag, and travel bag as well as a gift item for active and productive people of all ages.
Our Messenger bag is the best bag for men and women of all ages when compared to other bags available in online as well as offline market as it is made using long-lasting, strong, ecofriendly natural cotton canvas without compromising important features such as trendy brand, stylish appearance, comfortable structure, improved durability, good stitching quality, and user-safety and environment-friendly identity.

name: Recycled News paper COLOUR pencils & Plantable Seed pencils
description:
Colour pencils: These unique pencils are wood-free and made from your daily newspaper! No Trees were harmed in the making of these pencils! Recycled Paper is tightly rolled around the graphite (lead) with super strength!
Seed Pencils: Plant your pencil and watch it grow! How you may ask? These newspaper pencils have a small bulb of seeds at the bottom, once your pencil is too short to use, you can plant it into a pot or your garden bed (step wise instructions on the box) and watch the seeds sprout into a plant.
Makes a great gift for fellow ecowarriors.
